name: Necromancer audit: Cycle of Death grants 5% spell haste (#968)
contract: Cycle of Death 560727 (CharacterAdvancement 11904, Death tab, class 23) reads 'Increases your spell haste by $s1%.' Spell.dbc: a passive (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE) whose only effect is aura 216 SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS on the caster, BasePoints 4 + DieSides 1 = 5. AuraEffect::HandleModCastingSpeed applies it natively to UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED, so the cast-speed multiplier falls to 1/1.05 = 0.95238, and a hasted magic cast such as Sacrifice Undead 805027 (SpellCastTimes 16 = 1500 ms, DmgClass magic) takes 1428 ms instead of 1500 ms. Unlearning the passive restores both.

steps.label: CONTROL: Sacrifice Undead starts as a 1.5 s cast
SETUP: the Cycle of Death passive is active
Unlearning restores the cast speed multiplier
